mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment becomes more accommodative.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede economic slowdowns and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential investment (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 35% of instances when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 315), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 35% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 315 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising HOUST are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the level of non-farm payrolls below 155,000 thousand (155 million) signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS < 155000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index, 2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 30% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with lower economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the labor market weakness typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high UNRATE periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
